fixes: Reject an extensionless HTML response received instead of the requested live playlist.
Preserve upstream failure when retries exhaust available accounts instead of reporting capacity.
Align web playback recovery with a playlist segment boundary and increase live buffer allowance.
limitations: Real playback checks used FFmpeg against the published bridge, not a physical Android app.
Chile and Argentina still produced H.264 decoder warnings during completed playback.
Argentina produced the same warnings in a segment downloaded directly from the provider.
Buffer settings and recovery cannot repair corrupt frames in the original provider encoding.
No concurrent-load benchmark or guarantee of all provider signals is implied.
